top_signals.title: Russia’s Hybrid War Has Entered a Dangerous New Phase
top_signals.summary: Julianne Smith, who represented the United States at NATO during the Biden administration, argues that Russian hybrid warfare in Europe is escalating quickly, and NATO is not doing enough to deter it. Putin is attempting to discourage support for Ukraine and undermine faith in Article 5, and NATO is responding with an outdated playbook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Big Banks Set to Report Trading Haul of $19 Billion
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan expects a mixed-bag when it comes to earnings results from Wall Street's big banks. JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo and Citi all report Tuesday. The banks are expected to unveil a quarterly-stock trading haul of nearly $19 billion.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: US Mortgage Rates Rise for Seven Straight Weeks
top_signals.summary:
US mortgage rates increased for seven straight weeks for the first time in three years, adding pressure to an already weak housing market.
Selma Hepp, Chief Economist at Cotality, discusses home sales and the outlook for mortgage rates and refinancing. (Source: Bloomberg)
